adjudication.rationale: In `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the secret check uses `req.headers[process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME || "calcom-webhook-secret"]`. In Node/Next, incoming header keys are effectively lowercase, so if `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME` is configured with mixed case, this lookup will return `undefined` and the request will always be rejected (403). The diff partially mitigates this by documenting in `.env.example` that the header name “Should be in lowercase”, so it’s a real configuration footgun rather than an inherent functional defect when correctly configured; making the code normalize (`toLowerCase()`) would harden it.
